item.title: Trump's 'Hebrew Hammer' wins Republican congressional nomination
item.description:
Republican congressman Randy Fine clinched the GOP nomination in Florida's 6th Congressional District despite a bitter campaign marked by antisemitic attacks from social media influencer Dan Bilzerian, according to Fox News. The Trump-backed Jewish legislator's decisive victory demonstrates voter rejection of hate-filled rhetoric. Fine, known as the "Hebrew Hammer" for his Israel advocacy, will advance to November's general election in a safely Republican district.

item.title: Iran's nightmare: Hormuz slipping through fingers
item.description:
Iran is losing its grip on the Strait of Hormuz, with shipping analytics firm Kpler reporting that more than 80% of vessel transits over the past two weeks have taken the US-backed Omani route. Despite Tehran's attacks on ships and toll demands, most tankers are now defying Iran's authority, according to XXXX. Energy Secretary Chris Wright said combined oil transits total approximately 15 million barrels per day – far closer to pre-war levels than previously estimated.

item.title: Personalized cancer vaccine: Moderna news leads to market frenzy
item.description:
An experimental personalized cancer vaccine developed by Moderna and Merck has cleared its first late-stage clinical trial, meeting its primary endpoint in more than 1,100 melanoma patients. The mRNA shot, used in combination with Keytruda, significantly extended the time patients remained disease-free following surgery. The results sent Moderna stock soaring approximately 90% in premarket trading, while Merck shares rose over 8%. Regulatory talks are expected to begin within months.
